chronology_notes.note: The source is dated 2026-04-21 and should be treated as the later classroom compression after the March Iran-war interview cluster rather than an origin for the no-exit, war-logic, or escalation-ladder formulations.

Jiang's April 21 source explicitly shifts the analytic object from daily Trump signals to a five-to-ten-year Pentagon strategy frame, so later public compression should preserve the difference between short-term ceasefire theater and longer war architecture.

The closing forecast distinguishes short-term apparent U.S. gains from long-term imperial loss and retreat to the Western Hemisphere; do not collapse this into either U.S. omnipotence or immediate defeat.
